mkdir -p .github/workflows && cat > .github/workflows/ci.yml <<'EOF'
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          # Pinned exactly: Node 24 breaks the jsdom tests (localStorage clash).
          node-version: '22.11.0'
          cache: npm
      # No package-lock.json is committed, so `npm ci` is unavailable.
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test
EOF
